* '''PC-E1''' ([[Maul In Scimitar (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Once per battle, may lose 1 Force to 'cloak' (either add one destiny to total power or make this starship immune to attrition &lt; 6).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Maul In Scimitar]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Maul In Scimitar]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Maul In Scimitar”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
